summary: Official Lufeng Natural Resources Bureau material establishes a local registry/cadastral custodian and documents a map-based real-estate query service, but the linked public route requires real-name authentication and returned no usable anonymous response. No safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified; no sample GeoJSON is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Simplified-Chinese discovery queries, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-11768-lufeng.json.
requestOutcomes: Official Lufeng custodian and service-notice pages returned HTTP 200 through first-party inspection. The documented Guangdong map-query route returned an empty HTTP reply over HTTP and HTTP 502 over HTTPS in bounded TLS-verified requests. No viewer configuration, schema, CRS, or anonymous parcel geometry response was exposed.
